name: Sailor Moon Dating Simulator: Sailor Saturn
source:
The goal of the game is to win love of Hotaru Tomoe by asking her out on dates and giving her gifts.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20080701130357/http://sailorvgame.org/mg/smds/smds_saturn.htm]Sailorvgame.org[/url]]
translation:
游戏目标是通过邀请土萌萤约会并赠送礼物，赢得她的爱情。

[摘自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20080701130357/http://sailorvgame.org/mg/smds/smds_saturn.htm]Sailorvgame.org[/url]]
